howToApply: Download the prescribed application form (Annexure-1) from the advertisement.
Fill in the application form completely with all required details.
Attach self-attested copies of all necessary supporting documents, Educational Qualifications and Work Experience.
Combine the duly filled application and all self-attested supporting documents into a single PDF file (size not exceeding 5 MB).
Send the PDF file to the email ID: chqrectt@aai.aero on or before the closing date, i.e., 01.10.2026.

Ensure that the email ID provided in the application is maintained active for further communication.

title: Indian Coast Guard Recruitment 2026 – Chargeman Posts
shortInfo: Indian Coast Guard has announced notification for Chargeman posts. Required qualification: Diploma. Last date to apply: 24-11-26.

vacancyList.postName: Chargeman (General Central Service, Group 'B', Non-Gazetted, Non-ministerial)

howToApply: Fill the application form in English or Hindi as per the prescribed format given at Annexure-1.
Affix a self-attested colour photograph on the application form.

Attach photocopies of the following documents, duly self-attested with name and date: Aadhaar card, Matriculation or equivalent marksheet and certificate, UG/PG/Diploma marksheet and certificate, Latest Category Certificate (for reserved category candidates), Experience Certificate, PwBD Certificate (if applicable), NOC from employer (if applicable), Two latest passport size colour photographs.
Enclose a separate blank envelope with Rs. 50/- postal stamp pasted on it, addressed to yourself.
Super-scribe the envelope in BOLD letters: “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF CHARGEMAN” along with the category applied for.

Send the duly filled application with all attachments by ordinary post only to: The Director General, {For PD (Rectt)}, Coast Guard Headquarters, Directorate of Recruitment, C-1, Phase II, Industrial Area, Sector-62, Noida, U.P. – 201309.
Applications must reach by 24 Nov 26. Applications sent by hand or courier will not be considered.

title: AAI Recruitment 2026 – Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Apprentice Posts
shortInfo: AAI has announced notification for Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Apprentice posts. Required qualification: Graduate Degree / Diploma / ITI. Last date to apply: Update.
howToApply: Graduate/Diploma candidates must register on the NATS portal: https://nats.education.gov.in
ITI candidates must register on the NAPS portal: https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
After registration, search for the concerned AAI Establishment ID corresponding to your preferred location.
Submit the online application through the respective portal.
Applications submitted through any other mode shall not be accepted.
